items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...was Bab Frank that I ever heard of... [INTERVIEWEE] He played piccolo flute. He was practically all around me.

ctx.x: Oh, the last time I heard him play was the Union had a ball up on the Pithin Temple. Yes. And he was playing flute in that band.

Well, he played flute too. I didn't know that. Yes, he did. The only flute player, piccolo, really, was Bab Frank that I ever heard of in the old days that he played flute and jazz. He played a regular, a long flute then.
He played piccolo flute. He was practically all around me.
